scope: decomposition-oracle Gröbner stage only (matrix-F4 / Boolean F5 criterion / inherited F4 / split variable); not an end-to-end ECDLP cost
git_head_of_measured_sources: the commit that lands this manifest (the sources are identical to those hashed below; the bench and probe carry uncommitted-at-measurement changes only in what they *record*, not in what they solve)
note: every file here except oracle_ladder/K0_15_m3_rejected_*.json was produced by binaries built from the sources hashed below; the rejected-policy files come from an exploratory build whose code was removed before commit 1b409578
baseline: SolverEngine::MatrixF4 { max_degree: 3 } splitting on the lowest free variable — the pre-round default — selected on the final binary with KIC_F4_INHERIT=0 (SplitRule::Auto then resolves to LowestFree), so both sides of every comparison are the same build
unit: 64-bit word operations: elimination XORs on both sides; the inherited engine additionally charges one word operation per word read and per word written by specialisation (specialise_word_ops), which the from-scratch build never pays

host.note: shared cloud VM, no CPU pinning; wall time is a practicality note, not the metric

comparisons.same_tree: research/groebner_stage_20260915/compare.py — refuses unless verdict digest and every solver counter match rung for rung
comparisons.cross_tree: compare_cross_tree.py (this directory) — same instances, same targets decomposed, no exhausted budget, same oversize count; every counted decomposition was lifted and verified in the group by groebner_decompose; the tree's shape may differ

variants.f5_criterion: KIC_F4_INHERIT=0 KIC_F4_CRITERION=f5 (MatrixF4, LowestFree, rows filtered by the Boolean F5 criterion; criterion XORs charged)
variants.inherited_f4: the shipped default: InheritedF4 on every degree, SplitRule::Auto → HighestFree; root RREF below 24 variables, echelon-only at 24+
variants.inherited_f4_lowest: SOLVER_SPLIT_RULE=lowest (InheritedF4 on the historical tree; same tree as baseline)
variants.matrix_f4_highest: KIC_F4_INHERIT=0 SOLVER_SPLIT_RULE=highest (MatrixF4 on the new tree; same tree as inherited_f4)
variants.inherited_f4_rref_root: KIC_F4_INHERIT_ROOT=rref (default rule, fully reduced root everywhere)
variants.inherited_f4_rref_every_level: KIC_F4_INHERIT_RREF=1 (default rule, reduced form restored after every specialisation) — rejected control
variants.holdout_*: --ladder holdout for baseline, matrix_f4_highest and the default
variants.probes/: inherited_f4_probe under the shipped configuration: every captured node system reduced from scratch and specialised on the variable the production rule splits on, both values; decisive rows cross-checked against a from-scratch child reduction (args: a n targets degree m)
variants.oracle_ladder/cubic_cells_*.json: ic boundary --oracles on the K_0/2^9 m=3 and K_0/2^15 m=3 cells: reference (F4, lowest), F4 highest, inherited lowest, inherited highest (default)
variants.oracle_ladder/K0_15_m3_rejected_*.json: the two rejected per-node rescue policies under the historical rule — a drift-triggered basis rebuild (factor 1) and a cost-triggered switch of the subtree to the from-scratch engine (factor 2) — from an exploratory build; 0.48x and 0.45x against the reference
